text:
incident-bot: ALERT: kv-prod-4 observing sustained KV cache growth + continuous-batching backlog. paging rate x5, P99 small-request latency >2000ms, some timeouts. possible mixed long/short scheduling regression. creating thread and paging oncall. INC-2026-042 created :rotating_light:

maura: oncall here, grabbing it. summary pls and immediate mitigation options? :wave:

devin: saw an odd change in batch config pushed ~2h ago (batch_aggregation_ms from 25 -> 120) + a new 'batch-slab' scheduler variant. suspect longer batching mixing long requests into short ones.

sanjay: kv-prefetch also increased; logs show prefetch tasks exploded for a subset of tenants (hot-key set). possible cache blowup + larger batches amplifying tail.

tess: customer-impact: Support flagged 3 customers with >5% request errors and many small-query timeouts. one integration timed out repeatedly.

maura: immediate actions: 1) disable new scheduler variant, 2) reduce batch_aggregation_ms back to 25, 3) enable tight fairness (per-tenant credit). can someone prepare hotfix?

devin: preparing a hot-swap. plan: roll back scheduler to "rr-primary" on kv-prod-4 nodes and patch batch_aggregation_ms to 25ms. will do a canary on 2 nodes first.

rachel: I'll draft a short customer note for affected customers and update status page once we know impact window.

maura: assign owners: devin = runtime hotfix, sanjay = kv cache remediation (eviction/compaction), lila = routing/workarounds, rachel = comms. I'll coordinate oncall.

lila: short-term workaround: route small/default requests to dedicated small-req pool (pool-small-1) via feature-flag. spinning up routing rule now.

devin: canary patch commands:
```
kubectl label nodes kv-prod-4-02 hotfix-canary=true
kubectl patch cm batch-config -n runtime --patch '{"data":{"batch_aggregation_ms":"25","scheduler":"rr-primary"}}'
```
Applying to 2 canary nodes now. monitoring p99.

incident-bot: deploy-bot started canary deployment by devin on kv-prod-4-02, kv-prod-4-03.

sanjay: running an aggressive KV compaction/eviction on hot shard sets to reclaim memory. will also temporarily cap prefetch concurrency to 4. command: `kvctl compact --shard=hot-07 --max-threads=4`

maura: monitor key metrics: paging rate, mem.used, batch queue depth, small-request P99, and error-rate per-tenant. post metrics here every 60s.

devin: canary results after 3 min: small-request P99 dropped from ~2200ms -> ~300ms on canaries, CPU stable, paging decreased ~40%. rolling to remaining nodes with 30s stagger.

lila: routing rule applied for high-risk tenants, traffic moved -> pool-small-1. one tenant shows immediate improvement.

rachel: Incident status draft: "We experienced elevated latencies and timeouts due to a scheduling and batching regression. A configuration rollback and routing mitigations are in progress. Some clients experienced degraded performance for ~2h. Remediation underway." sending to legal/ops review.

maura: after full roll, metrics look back to normal. paging returned to baseline, mem used down ~22%, error rate back to normal. keeping process open for postmortem.

devin: created PR to add safer gating for batch_aggregation_ms changes + automated perf smoke test that simulates mixed short/long workloads. link: https://git.internal/repo/pull/4921

sanjay: follow-up step: identify hot-key tenants and add sharding/hotset isolation. will propose a prefetch budget limiter to avoid explosion in low-latency paths.

lila: suggest a temporary rate cap policy on large requests to prevent long-requests from starving small ones while we implement fair-queue scheduler.

maura: agreed. action items: devin implement gating + smoke tests, sanjay implement prefetch budget and hotset isolation, lila implement permanent routing rule for small reqs, rachel publish status update now that mitigations succeeded.

rachel: status page updated: "Mitigation complete. Full service restored for affected customers. Investigation continues." (INC-2026-042) :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: canary -> prod rollout completed by devin at 2170012550.

maura: handing off to SRE postmortem owners. I'll run blameless postmortem in 48h. closing oncall shift in 30m. thanks all. :tada:

incident-bot: NOTE: attach logs and sample traces to INC-2026-042 ticket for PM/eng review.

devin: quick note — the rollback uncovered a separate minor regression in packer that delayed batch flush on high-token counts; created issue #1287. will tackle after postmortem.

sanjay: capturing metric deltas and a replay of mixed workload tests for root cause.

maura: last check — any remaining customer impact?

rachel: none reported in last 15m. closing incident thread after postmortem scheduled. :lock:
